blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–The Office of the Solicitor General (OSG) on Thursday welcomed the Supreme Court (SC) ruling confirming that unprogrammed appropriations are constitutional as a budgetary mechanism. At the same time, it announced that it will seek clarification and partial reconsideration of the specific safeguards imposed by the high court. “The OSG respects the decision and welcomes the Court’s principal ruling that unprogrammed appropriations, as a budgetary mechanism, are not unconstitutional,” the OSG stated. The decision, written by Senior Associate Justice Marvic Leonen declared the 2024 and 2025 national budgets unconstitutional over congressional increases of P449.5 billion and P17.99 billion, respectively, beyond […]...
